tha-ap312:1.1: Pabbhāradāyaka.] Piyadassino bhagavato pabbhāro sodhito mayā / ghaṭakañ ca upaṭṭhāsiṃ paribhogāya tādino. // //
tha-ap312:2.1: Tam me buddho viyākāsi Piyadassī mahāmuni: / sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu dhajālu haritāmayo // //
tha-ap312:3.1: Nibbattissati so yūpo ratanañ ca anappakaṃ / pabbhāradānaṃ datvāna kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap312:4.1: Ito battiṃsakappamhi Susuddho nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap312:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pabbhāradāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap312:10.1: Kesaraṃ-Gandham-Annañ ca Dhammasañña-Phalena ca Pasād'-Ārāmadāyī ca Lomako Buddhasaññako Pabbhārado ca gāthāyo ekūnapaññāsa kittitā.
